path_step: Student attempts to delete a course.
test_scenario: Verify that a student, who is not authorized to delete courses, cannot initiate or perform a course deletion.
test_case_title: Verify student cannot delete a course
pre_condition: A student account is registered and logged in. An existing course is available on the Dashboard (e.g., enrolled).
expected_result: The 'Edit Course' button (or any equivalent deletion option) is not visible or is disabled for the student on the Dashboard/Course Details page. If somehow accessible, an authorization error should prevent the action.
post_condition: No course is deleted. Student remains logged in.

test_steps.step: Verify that no 'Edit Course' button or 'Delete Course' option is visible next to any course.
If an 'Edit Course' button is visible, click it and verify access is denied or no deletion option is present in the modal.
If the student somehow bypasses UI and attempts a direct API call for deletion, verify an authorization error is returned.

uncovered_conditions: Role-based access control for course deletion.
Preventing unauthorized users (students) from deleting courses.
